                                      Wide tables



                                     2 March 2026


A table with a long text under a short header gets most of the width.

Plot              Note
A1                Sunny corner by the old fence; needs extra watering during dry
                  weeks and shade cloth from June.
B2                Clay soil, improved with compost last autumn; good for beans and
                  squash.
